apr 21 Notes:


I took a winning trade of about 500 today and it should have been 1000 but due to me messing up a lot at the end of the trade I got stopped in profit. Definitely deserved and lesson will be learned.
,
Today what I was thinking was pretty obvious, we had asian and london lows all stacked up and I wanted to see them get taken at market open and trade into the discount of the range. That is exactly what happened and we got an external and internal smt and then we made a 5min cisd, but I didn’t enter right off of that, I waited for bullish close out of it and then entered off of a 1 minute gap. (Screenshot 1-3)
,
My initial take profit can be seen in screenshot 2 and that would have hit, but then the trade was going so well and I thought it would go to all time highs, but we got an smt at the high of my initial tp and at that point I definitely should have taken profit, but I think it is safe to say I got a little greedy. I got stopped at the 10:00 swing low which I thought would be the only manipulation for the 4h candle, but we went further.
,
The short off of the 5min rb that stopped me out actually would have been a good trade too, we have an smt, entry trigger and el. The only thing that would have made me fad it most likely is there isn’t really a clear enough bearish dol to make me short at all time highs. (Screenshot 4)
,
Another potential trade that I saw was the 1h wick at the bottom of the range gave perfect delivery with a 1min rb. If I was trading pm session today, this is definitely a trade that I would consider and most likely take. (Screenshot 5 & 6)
,
The lesson from today is that I should just trust my initial judgement and don’t adjust a trade that is in progress or exit a trade in progress. My best judgement is going to come before a big green or red number is being displayed on my screen so trust that.

Alright finally back after a week break and honestly I really needed that, tried my hardest to just be outside everyday go on some hikes with my boys and yeah,

I think I found out what was causing my over trading and it was just, 

rushing the process because i feel as though i need to retire my parents right now which just had the opposite effect 

Being scared to lose, id close trades early then see it hit tp and then revenge trade

fomo, id call out a trade in my head then dont take it and then it turns out to be a winner which causes me to just again over trade

and finally was my leverage, I wanted quick big wins with 1 mini but the losses are just way to much which causes me to leverage even higher to win back the losses.
